ballots.name: Noor
ballots.reason: Separate checkouts and installation approval do not establish limits on unsolicited execution, credential access, or resource use before installation.

ballots.name: Jonas
ballots.reason: I want this capability, but fact-finding showed we lack execution isolation, resource bounds, deduplication, and a review queue, so I'd only support a revised version with those prerequisites.

ballots.name: Lena
ballots.reason: Version 1 provides no cap, deduplication, or triage mechanism, so it converts agent initiative into an unbounded, unpredictable stream of review requests on the owner's desk without any throttle to protect their attention.
